summary: Education is a fundamental right, yet many children in hard-to-reach areas lack access to reliable and affordable internet connectivity. This project aims to bridge this gap by providing schools with fast and reliable internet connectivity, empowering children and their families to access education and technology. The initiative focuses on usability and scalability to enhance global educational access, particularly in remote areas. By leveraging innovative technologies, partnerships, and incentives, the project promotes transparency, trust, and accountability in the delivery of these services. The beneficiaries of this project are children and their families in remote areas, with a focus on educational access and digital empowerment. The project operates in a global context, with a specific emphasis on underserved communities.
